component.name: KiteDB
component.summary: A simple, native client for MySQL and PostgreSQL

description.p: Browse tables, edit data in place and run SQL against MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL servers.

ul.li: Saved connections with passwords kept in the system keyring
Paged data grid with sorting, filters, inline editing and CSV export
Staged edits saved in one transaction
SQL editor with highlighting, completion and query cancelling
